Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: Some projects I've built to explore, learn, and solve real problems.

umbrachat.title: UmbraChat
umbrachat.description: A real-time chat platform with WebSocket communication, message threads, user anonymity, and expiring message history.
umbrachat.detail: A full-stack real-time messaging application built with Next.js on the frontend and NestJS on the backend, using PostgreSQL for message persistence and WebSockets for low-latency, bidirectional communication. It supports public and private chat rooms, conversation threads, and online presence detection.
challenges: Designing a message threading system that organizes replies in a hierarchical structure.
Optimizing PostgreSQL queries for fast message retrieval across large conversation histories.
Building real-time typing indicators and presence tracking without flooding the WebSocket connection.

knowmeet.title: KnowMeet
knowmeet.description: A mobile app for sharing digital business cards and social media links via QR codes. Built with React Native for a smooth cross-platform experience.
knowmeet.detail: A React Native mobile application that lets users create and share digital business cards with instant QR code generation. Each card bundles social media profiles, contact links, and a scannable QR that others can scan to connect instantly. Designed for networking events, meetups, and everyday professional interactions.
challenges: Building a smooth QR generation and scanning system that works offline without internet dependency.
Designing a card customization engine with multiple templates and color schemes.
Implementing deep linking so that each shared card opens directly in the app when scanned.
Optimizing card loading performance to handle hundreds of shared contacts without lag.

devfolio.title: DevFolio
devfolio.description: A modern, multi-language developer portfolio built with Next.js and internationalization, featuring a clean dark/light theme and responsive design.
devfolio.detail: A personal developer portfolio website showcasing projects, technologies, and experience. Built with Next.js App Router, next-intl for multi-language support, Tailwind CSS for styling with dark/light theme support, and a clean, responsive design optimized for performance and accessibility.
challenges: Implementing full internationalization with dynamic route segments and localized metadata.
Designing a theme system with CSS custom properties that supports both dark and light mode seamlessly.
Building a responsive layout that adapts gracefully from mobile to desktop while maintaining visual hierarchy.
Creating reusable component patterns and shared style constants to maintain consistency across the site.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Crafting Code with Purpose
about.p1: Graduate in Web Application Development (CFGS DAW) with a deep passion for technology. Throughout my training I specialized in FullStack web development, working with modern technologies across the entire stack — from interactive frontends with frameworks like Next.js and React, to robust backends with Node.js, NestJS and APIs, and cloud services on AWS.
about.p2: My approach combines solid technical skills with a focus on solving real problems. I enjoy creating scalable, efficient applications, deploying them on AWS cloud infrastructure, optimizing performance, and designing intuitive interfaces that make a difference in the user experience.
about.p3: I firmly believe in continuous learning. The tech world moves fast, and I love keeping up with new trends, tools, and methodologies to always deliver the best solutions.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What type of development do you do?
faq.a1: I specialize in FullStack web development, working on both the frontend and backend of web applications. From interactive user interfaces with modern frameworks to robust APIs and database design.
faq.a2: I enjoy working with TypeScript, Next.js, and NestJS. I'm also passionate about React for frontend, PostgreSQL for databases, and AWS for cloud infrastructure — always exploring new tools that can improve my workflow.
faq.a3: Yes, I'm currently open to new projects and collaborations. Whether freelance, part-time, or full-time opportunities, I'm excited to take on new challenges.
faq.q4: What type of projects interest you?
faq.a4: Projects involving modern web technologies — from SaaS platforms and e-commerce to custom applications and APIs. I love challenges that require creative problem-solving.
faq.a5: Clean code, scalability, and user experience. I believe in writing maintainable code, following best practices, and always putting the end user first.
faq.q6: Do you work remotely or freelance?
faq.a6: Yes, fully comfortable working remotely with freelance experience. Organized, communicative, and used to working with distributed teams.
faq.q7: How do you stay up to date?
faq.a7: Continuous learning is part of my routine. I follow industry leaders, read technical blogs, experiment with new technologies, and believe every project is an opportunity to learn.
